resources.string: A small volume display for your TV apps.
1. Open Accessibility settings.\n2. Enable TV Volume Overlay.\n3. Adjust the volume with your TV remote.
Android 13+ · HDMI ARC / eARC\nYour receiver must report its volume through HDMI-CEC.
No Internet access. No screen reading. No key interception.
Open Accessibility in your TV settings.

Displays receiver volume above TV apps. Uses only activity package/class metadata to hide on TV input screens. Never reads screen content, filters remote keys or changes volume. Disable this service to stop the overlay.
Sample level 21 / 100. No audio is changed.
Leave blank for Volume. Muted replaces the label while muted.
Avoids a second bar over the receiver’s own display. May also hide on live TV in the same input app. Detection depends on TV firmware.

The service keeps working. Reopen through TV Settings → Accessibility → TV Volume Overlay → Settings, then turn this option off. Some TVs do not provide this Settings button; in that case use ADB to open the app (see README). Your launcher may cache the icon briefly.
